name: waqt
description: Free, self-hosted coding time tracker. Works with every WakaTime editor plugin and runs on Cloudflare's free plan.

API_KEY.description: Your secret key. It **must be a lowercase UUID v4** (the WakaTime plugins reject anything else). Generate one at [uuidgenerator.net/version4](https://www.uuidgenerator.net/version4) or run `crypto.randomUUID()` in your browser console. You'll use it to log in and in `~/.wakatime.cfg`.
